about: What the ledger refuses before an event is written. `json`: valid JSON text, parsed by each language's own parser; aisc_identity.ledger_events (event, _check) and shared/ledger-ts (ledgerSafe, eventBody) refuse every one. `platform` says what platform_service/ledger/canonical.py does with it: `refuses`, or `keeps` when RFC 8785 has a form for it (U+0000 as \u0000, 1e21 as a number) and only the emit-side check refuses it, because jsonb cannot hold U+0000 and keeps 1e21 as an integer beyond 2**53. `values`: what JSON text cannot carry, built by each test in its own language under these names; every checker refuses each one a language can build. Copied unchanged into apps/qualification and apps/controls (test/fixtures/ledger).
